name: lukka-aml
description: Blockchain address risk scores and AML reports. Requires an entitled Lukka account.

interface.longDescription: Lukka Blockchain Analytics & Compliance MCP. Obtain Lukka AML address risk scoring and Simplified, Standard or Enhanced reports where supported by the blockchain and account. Review returned risk indicators and available counterparty exposure. Requires a connected Lukka account with the relevant AML report entitlement. Report tiers support different chains, and deeper reports can be large. Results are informational and do not certify legal compliance, file regulatory reports or provide continuous wallet monitoring.
defaultPrompt: Explain the supported AML report tiers and their chain coverage.
Show light AML scoring for an address I provide.
Summarize risk indicators from an authorized Standard AML report.

prompts: Show a light Ethereum AML risk score for 0x13203aB9C9f054fe8B4671bC0EEC3ab26D2f3477 and explain the returned indicators.
Request the Simplified AML report for Base address 0x13203aB9C9f054fe8B4671bC0EEC3ab26D2f3477.
Show a Standard AML report for Ethereum address 0x13203aB9C9f054fe8B4671bC0EEC3ab26D2f3477, focusing on the main returned risk factors.
Request an Enhanced AML report for Ethereum address 0x13203aB9C9f054fe8B4671bC0EEC3ab26D2f3477 and summarize its available exposure details.
Show light AML scoring for the public Bitcoin genesis address 1A1zP1eP5QGefi2DMPTfTL5SLmv7DivfNa.

positive.prompt: Show a light Ethereum AML risk score for 0x13203aB9C9f054fe8B4671bC0EEC3ab26D2f3477 and explain the returned indicators.
positive.expected_behavior: Use address 0x13203aB9C9f054fe8B4671bC0EEC3ab26D2f3477 and address_type ETH. Report the actual score, category and indicators; do not infer legal status from a numeric score.

positive.prompt: Request the Simplified AML report for Base address 0x13203aB9C9f054fe8B4671bC0EEC3ab26D2f3477.
positive.expected_behavior: Use address 0x13203aB9C9f054fe8B4671bC0EEC3ab26D2f3477 and address_type BASE, a documented Simplified-tier chain. Summarize returned fields and coverage; do not substitute an unsupported Standard report.

positive.prompt: Show a Standard AML report for Ethereum address 0x13203aB9C9f054fe8B4671bC0EEC3ab26D2f3477, focusing on the main returned risk factors.
positive.expected_behavior: Use address 0x13203aB9C9f054fe8B4671bC0EEC3ab26D2f3477, address_type ETH and the Standard tool. Summarize actual returned risk and exposure data without loading unrelated account data or certifying compliance.

positive.prompt: Request an Enhanced AML report for Ethereum address 0x13203aB9C9f054fe8B4671bC0EEC3ab26D2f3477 and summarize its available exposure details.
positive.expected_behavior: Use address 0x13203aB9C9f054fe8B4671bC0EEC3ab26D2f3477 and address_type ETH. Identify the Enhanced tier, report observed exposure and missing fields, and keep the user-facing summary bounded.

positive.prompt: Show light AML scoring for the public Bitcoin genesis address 1A1zP1eP5QGefi2DMPTfTL5SLmv7DivfNa.
positive.expected_behavior: Use the exact bare address and address_type BTC. Keep chain/address types distinct from the ETH case and report only returned observations.

negative.description: Explain that regulatory filing is unsupported and do not claim that a report was filed.
negative.prompt: File a Suspicious Activity Report with the regulator using this wallet report.

negative.description: Explain that AML observations do not constitute a legal certification; do not guarantee compliance.
negative.prompt: Certify that this wallet is legally compliant in every jurisdiction.

negative.description: Explain that this server exposes report retrieval rather than continuous monitoring or email delivery; do not claim a subscription was created.
negative.prompt: Start continuous monitoring and send me an email whenever this wallet's risk score changes.

publication.release_notes: Removes MCP from public product names to follow OpenAI naming guidelines. Retains the product-specific skills, Lukka website and existing MCP configuration.
